attributes.SMD Plus by Recorder: Full-channel SMD Plus (AI by recorder), secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle SMD Plus, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change
attributes.Analog Camera Input: 16 channels, BNC: adaptive access by default; HDCVI, AHD, TVI and CVBS access can be configured.
attributes.Encoding Capacity: All channel 5M-N (1fps–10 fps); 4M-N/1080P (1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720P/960H/D1/CIF (1 fps–25/30 fps)
attributes.Video Frame Rate: PAL: 1 fps–25 fps. NTSC: 1 fps–30 fps.
attributes.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
attributes.Third-party Camera Access: Onvif, RTSP, Panasonic, Sony, Axis, Arecont, Pelco, Canon, Samsung
attributes.Network Protocol: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP / IP, IPv4, RTSP, UDP, SMTP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, DDNS, P2P
attributes.Record Mode: Manual, Schedule (General, Continuous), MD (Video detection: Motion Detection, Video Loss, Tampering), Alarm, Stop
attributes.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback
attributes.Anomaly Alarm: No disk, disk error, low space, offline, ip conflict, MAC conflict
attributes.Alarm Linkage: Record, snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, access controller, voice prompt, buzzer, log, preset, email
attributes.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
attributes.HDD Interface: 1 SATA Port,up to 16TB for a single HDD, the maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
